description: Visakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh) [India], September 1: The Government of Andhra Pradesh, through its Department of Information Technology, Electronics & Communications (ITE & C), has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Tech Bharat Foundation to establish a groundbreaking AI Center of Excellence (CoE) in Visakhapatnam, aimed at advancing AI for Public Good.
body_lead: Andhra Pradesh Scales up its AI Leadership: MoU Signed with Tech Bharat Foundation to Launch India's First AI Center of Excellence for Public Good NewsVoir Visakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh) [India], September 1: The Government of Andhra Pradesh, through its Department of Information Technology, Electronics & Communications (ITE & C), has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Tech Bharat Foundation to establish a groundbreaking AI Center of Excellence (CoE) in Visakhapatnam, aimed at advancing AI for Public Good.
